title: 分配策略对比：Range 的偏差与 RoundRobin 的均衡
expected_output:
=== Range vs RoundRobin 的均衡性 ===

场景: 3 个 Topic x 3 分区 / 2 消费者
策略             各消费者分区数                              极差       最大负载
Range          [6, 3]                                3          6
RoundRobin     [5, 4]                                1          5

场景: 3 个 Topic x 4 分区 / 3 消费者
策略             各消费者分区数                              极差       最大负载
Range          [6, 3, 3]                             3          6
RoundRobin     [4, 4, 4]                             0          4

-> Range 的偏差来自「每个 Topic 独立取余, 余数落在同一批消费者身上」, 偏差被 Topic 数放大
-> RoundRobin 把全部分区拉平后轮转, 极差恒为 0 或 1

=== Sticky 的额外收益：以第 2 个场景为例，新增/移除一个消费者时只搬必要的分区 ===
旧分配（RoundRobin, 12 个分区均分）: [4, 4, 4]
-> Sticky 保持「均衡优先、搬迁最小」: 新增 1 个消费者时理论搬迁量约 12/4 = 3 个分区
   而 Eager 协议下旧分配会被完全丢弃, 12 个分区全部重新落位
code:
def range_assign(topics, C):
    """对每个 Topic 独立按区间分配（Kafka 默认策略）。"""
    assign = {c: [] for c in range(C)}
    for t, P in topics:
        q, r = divmod(P, C)
        idx = 0
        for c in range(C):
            take = q + (1 if c < r else 0)
            assign[c].extend("%s-%d" % (t, idx + k) for k in range(take))
            idx += take
    return assign


def roundrobin_assign(topics, C):
    flat = []
    for t, P in topics:
        flat.extend("%s-%d" % (t, i) for i in range(P))
    assign = {c: [] for c in range(C)}
    for i, p in enumerate(flat):
        assign[i % C].append(p)
    return assign


def report(name, assign):
    counts = [len(v) for _, v in sorted(assign.items())]
    print("%-14s %-28s %10d %10d" % (name, str(counts), max(counts) - min(counts), max(counts)))


CASES = [
    ("3 个 Topic x 3 分区 / 2 消费者", [("t1", 3), ("t2", 3), ("t3", 3)], 2),
    ("3 个 Topic x 4 分区 / 3 消费者", [("t1", 4), ("t2", 4), ("t3", 4)], 3),
]

print("=== Range vs RoundRobin 的均衡性 ===")
for desc, topics, C in CASES:
    print()
    print("场景:", desc)
    print("%-14s %-28s %10s %10s" % ("策略", "各消费者分区数", "极差", "最大负载"))
    report("Range", range_assign(topics, C))
    report("RoundRobin", roundrobin_assign(topics, C))
print()
print("-> Range 的偏差来自「每个 Topic 独立取余, 余数落在同一批消费者身上」, 偏差被 Topic 数放大")
print("-> RoundRobin 把全部分区拉平后轮转, 极差恒为 0 或 1")
print()
print("=== Sticky 的额外收益：以第 2 个场景为例，新增/移除一个消费者时只搬必要的分区 ===")
topics, C = [("t1", 4), ("t2", 4), ("t3", 4)], 3
rr3 = roundrobin_assign(topics, C)
flat = [p for _, v in sorted(rr3.items()) for p in v]
print("旧分配（RoundRobin, 12 个分区均分）:", [len(v) for _, v in sorted(rr3.items())])
print("-> Sticky 保持「均衡优先、搬迁最小」: 新增 1 个消费者时理论搬迁量约 12/4 = 3 个分区")
print("   而 Eager 协议下旧分配会被完全丢弃, 12 个分区全部重新落位")
